name: Minimal Bootable Game Entry
scope: make /game/index.html a zero-dependency bootable entry and isolate the full WebXR build at /game/full.html
notes: Replaced /game/index.html with a small zero-dependency HTML/CSS page that does not import Three.js, main.js, or any heavy game module.
Created /game/full.html as the separate full WebXR loader for the heavy 3D build, preserving the debug path without blocking the public game entry.
The game entry now immediately shows SVR Game Lobby, Moon, Mars, store buttons, Reiki Store, PGA Store, PGA Range, and Scorpion Room links.
If /game/ still shows the old boot screen after deployment, the issue is confirmed as deployment/cache/path serving stale files rather than code inside /game/index.html.
Website store Phase 99 hub navigation remains active: SVR Store, Reiki Store, PGA Store, Scorpion, Lounge, VR Gear, and Sponsors.
No Unity and no Azure. This remains WebEx/WebXR static game and website work.
